items.title: Render the direct missing-inventory recovery command
items.context: Propagate review_inventory_finalize as the actionable next step from the done_prepare and certification-window blocked path when no PRE_CERT inventory receipt exists in TEST.
items.userSees: User sees "Next: proof-or-stop review_inventory_finalize --storyId=B-xxxx" after done_prepare reports missing PRE_CERT inventory, instead of being sent back to done_required_validate.

happy.desc: When DONE-required validation is refused because no PRE_CERT inventory receipt exists, done_prepare exposes the exact review_inventory_finalize command.

edge.desc: When the same parser sees a non-inventory blocker or no authoritative Next line, done_prepare retains its existing caller-specific retry command.

adversarial.desc: A malformed or unrelated refusal message cannot inject an arbitrary shell command into the done_prepare next field; only the expected proof-or-stop command is propagated.

items.title: Prove recovery stays in TEST
items.context: Add a focused regression covering the B-45a0-shaped missing inventory path: finalization and retry must not require story_advance to DEV or a new REVIEW round.
items.userSees: User sees the blocked certification output point directly to "Next: proof-or-stop review_inventory_finalize --storyId=B-xxxx" while the story remains in TEST and no DEV or REVIEW transition is requested.

happy.desc: A TEST story with no current PRE_CERT inventory receipt gets the blocker-specific review_inventory_finalize next command from the shared certification choke.

edge.desc: An ADMITTED or RUNNING certification window continues to report done_required_validate as its next command, while a different blocked PRE_CERT reason keeps its own remediation command.

adversarial.desc: An inventory-completeness-only receipt remains non-authoritative and the recovery output never suggests story_advance to DEV or a new REVIEW round.
